title: kate-core: complete words from the buffer
summary: word_completions lists buffer words that start with the prefix before the caret. The word under the caret is omitted. Order is first appearance. This packet does not draw a popup. It does not edit kate-ui. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust. It does not need a window or a review by the owner. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

definitions.definition:
pub fn word_completions(
    buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer,
    at: kate_text::Offset,
    limit: usize,
) -> Vec<String>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: A word is a run of ASCII letters, digits, and underscore. The prefix is the word chars immediately before at. An empty prefix returns an empty vec. A limit of 0 returns an empty vec. Skip the word that contains at. Matching is case sensitive. lib.rs adds mod completion and re-exports word_completions. Do not edit kate-ui. A new Rust file starts with the LGPL-2.1-or-later SPDX header. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.
